description: Implementation of the QuicDataWriter class for writing various data types in the QUIC protocol, including methods for writing connection IDs, random bytes, and floating-point values.

classes.name: QuicDataWriter
classes.description: A class for serializing data into a buffer for QUIC protocol communication.

methods.name: WriteUFloat16
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit floating point value in a custom format.

methods.name: WriteConnectionId
methods.description: Writes a QuicConnectionId to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteRandomBytes
methods.description: Fills the buffer with cryptographically secure random bytes.

methods.name: WriteInsecureRandomBytes
methods.description: Fills the buffer with insecure random bytes.
